quiz1.missionText: I wonder if there are any scratches on the back. Swipe to the last photo to check

insight.title: How did swiping let you check it?
insight.subtitle: Checking multiple photos of a product is standard practice
insight.swipeTitle: Swipe left to see the next photo
insight.swipeDesc: Flea market apps allow sellers to upload multiple product photos. Swiping through all photos before buying is essential.
insight.checkTitle: Always check the back, scratches, and stains
insight.checkDesc: Not just the front — check the back, bottom, and areas near logos in all photos. This is the first step to avoiding disputes.
insight.dotTitle: Dot indicators show how many photos there are
insight.dotDesc: The dots below the image show which photo you are currently viewing. You can tell at a glance whether you have checked all of them.

quiz2.missionText: I want to compare this later — let me save it with a like for now

insight.title: How did the heart save it?
insight.subtitle: The like button is a wish list feature in flea market apps
insight.heartTitle: Heart saves items for later comparison
insight.heartDesc: Liked items are saved to a dedicated list so you can compare multiple candidates at once. A smart way to avoid impulse buying.
insight.priceDesc: When you like an item, you may receive a notification if the seller lowers the price. Just adding to favorites means you won't miss a deal.
insight.sellDesc: Items with many likes are popular and may sell out quickly. Checking the like count of other users helps you judge demand.

quiz3.missionText: Can I trust this seller? Let me check their profile and ratings

insight.title: How did the profile reveal trustworthiness?
insight.subtitle: A seller's rating is directly tied to transaction confidence
insight.ratingTitle: Star ratings show trustworthiness at a glance
insight.ratingDesc: Flea market apps accumulate ratings for every transaction. A highly rated seller is more likely to have an honest transaction history, giving you peace of mind.
insight.profileTitle: Tap the profile for detailed information
insight.profileDesc: Tapping the seller's name or rating area takes you to their detailed profile. Check their transaction history and comments to verify their track record.
insight.trustTitle: Number of ratings is also a trust indicator
insight.trustDesc: A high rating with few reviews is hard to judge. The more ratings a seller has, the more you can trust they have a consistent record.

quiz4.missionText: Alright, I've decided! Let's proceed to the purchase

insight.title: How did the bottom button let you buy?
insight.subtitle: A fixed purchase button is a universal design pattern in e-commerce apps
insight.fixedTitle: The fixed button at the bottom is the purchase funnel
insight.fixedDesc: Flea market apps and e-commerce sites commonly fix the purchase button at the bottom of the screen. You can proceed to purchase anytime regardless of scroll position.
insight.ctaDesc: Purchase buttons are often implemented in eye-catching colors like red or orange. They draw the user's attention and serve as a CTA (call to action) to prompt purchases.
insight.safeTitle: The purchase process has multiple steps
insight.safeDesc: This button is just the entry point to the purchase process. Steps like address confirmation and payment method selection follow, so accidental taps do not immediately complete a purchase.
